shell.title: Stadium Control
shell.stopMatchConfirm:
Stop and close match "{{home}} vs {{away}}"?

Score, events and sponsor logs stay saved for reporting. The display will be detached.
shell.newMatchCreatedOnly: Match created — activate it when ready in Setup or Match
shell.activateMatchHint: Activate a match via Start new match or the Setup tab.
shell.matchInfoPhaseHint: Set the phase via Screen & phase on the left. Current status:
shell.layoutHint: This is exactly the same layout as match mode. Drag a block by its grip; use the narrow top strip or the large area below to place it last.
shell.previewPaused: Preview paused outside the Match tab
shell.emptySponsorPreviewBody: Sponsor rotation is selected, but no sponsor file is currently playing. Show the scoreboard or add sponsor media first.
shell.moreControlsHint: All specialist controls remain directly available here.
shell.dropAtTop: Place at the top of this column
shell.dropAtBottom: Drop here to place at the bottom

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language of the control interface. Saved on this device.
language.label: Interface language

license.title: ArenaCue license
license.body: Activate this installation with your license key. Machine ID (for support):
license.keyTooShort: Enter your full license key (format ARENA-…).
license.afterActivate: After activation you can view your installations at arenacue.be/portal with the same key and email.

display.title: Screen & phase
display.stuckBody: The screen has not sent an update for {{seconds}}s while the timer is running. Restart the display window.
display.phaseHint: Set the match phase here. 1st/2nd half (and extra time) automatically start Scoreboard + sponsors. Other phases: scoreboard only (enable sponsors manually). No active match? Use Start new match or Setup.
display.noActiveMatch: No active match — phase buttons are disabled.
display.boardOnlyHint: no sponsor clips beside the scoreboard
display.sponsorsLicenseOff: Automatic sponsor rotation is disabled for this license plan{{plan}}. Operators can still start media manually.
display.quickLaunchHint: Warnings and fixed clips. One tap = fullscreen. Stop to go back.
display.quickLaunchEmpty: No quick buttons yet. In Library, tick “Quick button” on a clip.
display.quickMediaHint: Click Show; after the configured media duration the screen automatically returns to the previous live view.
display.quickMediaEmpty: No media yet. Add files through Media.
display.quickMediaSearchMore: Search to view all {{count}} media files. Favourites are always listed first.
display.quickMediaFileHint: Choose directly from a Windows folder. The file is only added to the library and will not appear on screen automatically.
display.quickMediaFileFailed: The file could not be shown
display.quickMediaFileAdded: {{name}} was added — choose Show or turn it into a quick button
display.quickMediaFileAddFailed: The file could not be added
display.quickMediaButtonsHint: Click a large button to show the media immediately.
display.quickMediaButtonsEmpty: No quick buttons yet. Click the star beside a media file.
display.quickMediaAllPinned: All media is pinned above as a quick button.
display.quickMediaRenameHelp: Choose a short, clear operator label for {{file}}. The file name itself will not change.
display.quickMediaRenameResetDone: Button label reset to the file name
display.quickMediaRenameFailed: Button label could not be saved
display.quickMediaButtonRemoved: Quick button removed; the media remains in the library
display.quickMediaRemoveFirstHelp: You are about to remove the ‘{{name}}’ quick button. The media file itself will remain in the library.

matchLive.title: Live match
matchLive.noMatch: No active match. Create or select one in Setup.
matchLive.subTitle: Substitution · {{team}}
matchLive.scorerHelp: Shared goal video (from Setup) or GOAL playlist is playing — pick the scorer for a personal clip if set (media or folder-imported goal video), otherwise the text goal graphic.
matchLive.lineupCountError: Choose 1 to {{n}} players per team on the field
matchLive.lineupHelp: Max. {{n}} players per team (no coaches). Sets who is on court for Substitution and updates when substitutions are shown. Default: first {{n}} by shirt number.
matchLive.subHelp: Left: who is on the field (per Field lineup), right: the bench. Pick out and in, optionally add to the list, then Start substitution on screen (about 6 s each). Without a lineup: first players by shirt number up to the sport maximum.
matchLive.noOnField: No players on the field according to the lineup — use Field lineup or check the team.
matchLive.noBench: No substitutes (all selected players are on the field, or too few players on the team).
matchLive.penaltyFollowsClock: Penalty time runs with the game clock
matchLive.periodEnded: Period over — select the next period

sponsors.noActiveLoops: none (no sponsor with budget + media in this segment, or phase without schedule).
sponsors.noMedia: No sponsors with linked active media. See Media → Sponsors.
sponsors.nuHint: The Now column shows remaining budget. With a connected stadium screen, time is deducted from actually played clips; otherwise it is an estimate from the schedule.
sponsors.hudInactiveBody: As soon as sponsor rotation is active, this shows the current sponsor, clip progress and the next scheduled moment.
sponsors.hudNoLiveClip: The schedule has this sponsor now, but the display is not sending a live clip. Open the stadium screen or check that this sponsor has active media.
sponsors.nextIn: Next sponsor on screen in {{sec}} s
sponsors.prematchWindowOpensIn: Sponsor schedule starts in {{sec}} s (window before kickoff). Scoreboard stays on until then.
sponsors.prematchTimelineDone: Prematch sponsor schedule is finished (kickoff reached or window over).
sponsors.noNext: No more sponsor slots in this block.
sponsors.playlistMatchHalf: Match half: sponsor loop is on playlist (no budget schedule to show).
sponsors.playlistHalftime: Half-time: sponsor loop is on playlist (no budget schedule to show).
sponsors.noBudgetInPhase: No sponsors with budget in this phase
sponsors.hudUnconfirmedHint: The scoreboard is not reporting this clip. It may not actually be on screen — check the display window.
sponsors.hudCapturePaused: External capture covers the scoreboard. Sponsor rotation is paused: no budget or proof-of-play is counted while the feed is on screen.

media.title: Sponsors & screen time
media.deleteSponsorConfirm: Delete sponsor? Linked media stay in the library.
media.introBody: Work step by step: link sponsor files and minutes, manage loose files in the library, and programme clips per phase in the rundown.
media.stepSponsorsHint: Main match sponsorship workflow: minutes per phase + media per sponsor.
media.stepLibraryHint: Manage all loose videos and images, test them, fix duration and link them later if needed.
media.stepPlaylistsHint: Fixed clip lists for moments without sponsor budget or for shared goal clips.
media.stepAutomationHint: Automatically show loose or general media once or repeatedly during the match.
media.libraryHelp: Videos: duration is read from the file automatically. Images: choose how long they show each time (you can adjust this later per item). Auto-created player goal videos (standalone player files) do not appear here — they stay available for the display.
media.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, type or sponsor…
media.hiddenTechnical: {{count}} technically hidden (e.g. auto player goal video)
media.groupHint: Grouped: Loose (no sponsor) then by sponsor. Link media mainly via the Sponsors tab.
media.libraryEmpty: No media files yet. Upload here or via Sponsors → add files.
media.searchEmpty: No media found for this search.
media.playlistsHelp1: Playlists are background lists (empty screen, pre-match, half-time, goal fallback). The match itself — clocked clips, post-match, loop — is programmed under Rundown.
media.playlistsHelp2: If sponsors have minutes filled in, the sponsor schedule mostly decides what you see. These playlists only fill in when there is no sponsor media.
media.goalPlaylistHint: Shared goal clip: only used when there is no shared goal video in Setup; otherwise that wins. Otherwise the first active item in this playlist.
media.cueInvalidInput: Choose media and enter a time like 12:30
media.cueRepeatInvalid: Check the start time, end time and interval (at least 0.5 minute).
media.cuesHelp: Schedule general or sponsor media on the match clock. Choose one moment or repeat the same clip every few minutes. The normal scoreboard and sponsor programme resumes automatically afterwards.
media.cueOnceHelp: The clip appears once at the selected time in this match phase.
media.cueRepeatHelp: Example: start at 10:00, every 5 minutes, through 40:00. The software creates all playback moments for you.
media.playNowLockedHint: During match half: sponsors via Sponsors (seconds per phase) and Display → Scoreboard + sponsors.
media.playbackWarnTitle: This video may not play on the stadium screen
media.playbackWarnHighFps: {{fps}} fps — Electron can freeze or stay black. Export as H.264, max. 1080p30.
media.playbackWarnCodec: Codec {{codec}} is not reliable here. Export as H.264 (mp4), 8-bit, max. 1080p30.
media.playbackWarnPixel: 10-bit or 4:2:2 is not supported. Export as H.264 yuv420p 8-bit.
media.playbackFixed: Video is ready for the screen
media.playbackFixHint: A H.264 1080p30 copy was created. The original file is unchanged.
media.sponsorCreated: Sponsor created — now add media and airtime
media.sponsorSimpleIntro: Create a sponsor, add files, and only then set the required airtime.
media.createSponsorHelp: Start with the sponsor name only. All media and timing settings follow in one overview.
media.afterSponsorCreateHelp: The new sponsor opens automatically. Add at least one image or video first; without media it will not appear on the scoreboard.
media.sponsorStep1Body: Pre-match, 1st half, 2nd half and half-time. Everything is in minutes.
media.sponsorStep2Body: Add files to the sponsor or attach existing media from the library.
media.sponsorStep3Body: Per file you can choose in which match phase it may appear.
media.sponsorsEmpty: No sponsors yet. Add one to set media and screen time.
media.orderResetFailed: Could not reset to default order
media.budgetHelp: Only active sponsors with media count. Empty = 0. Existing sponsors with a single match time in the database: put those minutes in 1st half; leave 2nd half at 0 unless you deliberately split.
media.budgetFootballHint: Football (and futsal in two-half mode) writes the existing minute columns.
media.budgetOtherHint: Minutes for this sport. Empty fields fall back to the football columns until you save. Labels follow the sponsor model from Setup.
media.defaultImageDurationHint: New uploads for this sponsor; videos follow the file.
media.rotationHelpMulti: Set the desired airtime for each file within one rotation round. The software automatically calculates the required full plays. Change order with ↑/↓ or dragging.
media.rotationHelpSingle: Set how many minutes this file should receive per rotation round. Total sponsor budgets per match phase remain leading.
media.repeatTitle: Technical number of full plays in one rotation round
media.clipAirtimeTitle: Desired total airtime for this file per rotation round
media.allPhasesHint: All phases active. Uncheck/check a phase to choose specifically.

reports.title: Proof of play
reports.empty: No play logs for this selection.
reports.licenseOff: Proof-of-play export is not available on this license plan.
reports.intro: Every completed sponsor clip play is logged automatically. Filter and export to Excel or PDF for advertisers or billing.
reports.brandIntro: Set the logo, colours and title used on the PDF you send to sponsors or commercial. Excel stays a data export.
reports.whyZero: Why is everything 0? The totals below are the sum of actually finished sponsor clips on the stadium display — not your configured sponsor seconds in Media. Until a clip has ended in this filter (or your filter excludes those logs), plays, screen time and fulfillment stay at 0. Let sponsors run on the display until a clip ends, or widen the date range and optionally choose “{{all}}”.
reports.statExpectedHint: per logged clip, not your sponsor budget

export.title: ArenaCue · Proof of play
export.noDetail: No detail rows for this filter.
export.detailHeading: Detail — all logged plays in this export

setup.venueBackupBody: Creates a ZIP with the local database (data/stadium.db) and a copy of uploads/. Also via the menu: File → Export venue backup.
setup.homeTeamBody: Everything for the home side in one place: club, visuals and players. This team is home by default for new matches.
setup.homeTeamPlayersHelp: Tap a player to set photo, goal video or lineup.
setup.otherTeamsBody: Away sides and extra clubs. The home team is above.
setup.goalIntroSaveFailed: Could not save goal intro video
setup.goalVisualSaveFailed: Could not save goal visual setting
setup.startBoardOnlyHelp: Safe default: show the match scoreboard immediately.
setup.startWithSponsorsHelp: Start the automatic sponsor rotation immediately.
setup.startWithSponsorsUnavailable: Add sponsor media first via Media → Sponsors.
setup.saveForLaterHelp: Create the match without changing the live display.
setup.name: Name
setup.setHomeFirst: First set a fixed home team on the Setup tab.
setup.awayShortMissing: Away team short name is missing
setup.matchesHelp: Close a match after it ends: the display is disconnected. Sponsor play logs stay on this match — filter in Reports by match.
setup.goalIntroBody: Takes priority over the GOAL playlist in Media. Then you pick the scorer; if they have a personal clip (media or imported goal video), that celebration follows.
setup.goalPlusBehaviorBody: Choose per side whether the goal button starts a visual or only increases the score.
setup.importVisualsBody: Pick a folder of files and assign them manually to the correct home player.
setup.setHomeHint: Create a team first, then pick it here as the home side.
setup.idleBody: With an empty playlist the stadium screen can show an optional fixed clip or image; otherwise your fixed home team logo. Without a home team you see a short message.
setup.sponsorModelBody: Choose when sponsor clips may run. Football always keeps the existing model: pre / 1st half / break / 2nd half / post.
setup.sponsorModelFootballFixed: Football is locked to two play blocks and uses the existing minute columns.
setup.layoutPerPeriod: Per period (each quarter or set separately)
setup.layoutHintTwoBlocks: Same rhythm as football. With four periods the first block continues across Q1+Q2.
setup.layoutHintPerPeriod: Each period has its own window. A separate pot runs between periods while the clock is stopped.
setup.layoutHintInplay: One pot during play (wall clock for volleyball) and one pot between periods or sets.
setup.activateClosedTitle: A closed match cannot be activated
setup.closeMatchConfirm:
Close match "{{home}} vs {{away}}"?

The display will be disconnected from this match (if active). Sponsor play logs stay available for per-match reporting.
setup.reopenMatchConfirm: Reopen match "{{home}} vs {{away}}" for live control?
setup.deleteTeamConfirm: Delete team and all players? Matches involving this team will also be deleted.
setup.lineupVideoHelp: Fullscreen video during Player intro on the screen. Takes priority over the fixed photo/text template. You can also link the same files via Setup → folder import “Lineup videos…”.
setup.lineupBrowserHint: In the browser: upload a video file; in the desktop app you can pick a path directly.
setup.goalCelebrationHelp: Played fullscreen after this player is confirmed as the scorer. Upload videos in the Media tab first.
setup.rosterDuplicateNumber: Shirt number {{number}} appears more than once
setup.rosterHelp: Fill the full list below. Empty rows are ignored. An extra empty row appears automatically when you start typing.
setup.desktopOnly: Only available in the desktop app
setup.selectFileFirst: Select a file on the left first
setup.chooseFolderHint: Choose a folder above to show its contents.
setup.matchSponsorLeadHelp: With match sponsor: automatic fullscreen from {{minutes}} min before this time until kick-off (SETUP/PREMATCH only).
setup.scheduleInvalidPrematchDesc: Enter a non-negative whole number of minutes, or leave empty for automatic.
setup.quickStartActivateHelp: Put this match live on the control and stadium screens right away.
setup.quickStartSponsorsHelp: Set Display to Scoreboard + sponsors. Use the prematch window above so the schedule starts on time (not only when the sum of sponsor seconds begins).
setup.scheduleKickoffEmptyHelp: Empty = no scheduled time. With sponsor: from {{minutes}} min before until this time automatically on the display (SETUP/PREMATCH).
setup.prematchWindowHelp: With a scheduled {{start}} the sponsor schedule starts automatically that many minutes before {{start}} and ends at {{start}}. Entered “pre-match” sponsor seconds (e.g. 2 min) are spread across that window — not all back-to-back. Enter e.g. 30 for a half-hour prematch spread; leave empty to use the sum of sponsor budgets as the window. Without {{start}}: spread starts when you enable sponsor rotation (PREMATCH).
setup.themeBody: Drag the real boxes (home, away, clock, video/sponsors) on the 16:9 canvas. Pick colours beside it. Save to update the stadium screen.
setup.themePlacerHelp: Drag a component. Pull the white corner to resize. The video box stays 16:9 — for LED media and sponsoring.
setup.themePlacerHelpFull: Drag home, away and the clock on the full scoreboard. No sponsor box — this is the in-play screen.
setup.themeSlotHint: Selected: {{slot}}. Drag or pull the corner.
setup.themePreviewHint: Live preview with your current clubs. Save to update the stadium screen.
setup.themeLayoutModeHelp: Choose how score, clock and sponsors sit on the LED. Automatic still uses the L-frame beside sponsors.
setup.themeLayoutHelp_auto: Fullscreen until sponsors or a goal need the side panel. Once the L-frame appears during a half it stays for the rest of that half.
setup.themeLayoutHelp_left-l: Always left column + content area, even without sponsors.
setup.themeLayoutHelp_full: Wide board; L only when sponsors or a goal need the side panel.
setup.themeLayoutHelp_bottom-strip: Low bar at the bottom, content above — for narrow LEDs.
setup.themeVisibleHelp: Toggle elements. Applies to fullscreen, L-bar and bottom strip.
setup.themeSponsorRepeat: Restart sponsor budget after a full round
setup.themeSponsorRepeatHelp: When all sponsors have used their planned time, rotation starts again until the phase changes. Off (default): then scoreboard only, unless you use a two-clip playlist for an endless loop.
setup.themeFullHint: Typography above (font and clock colours) also applies to the full screen.
setup.themeFullAlphaHelp: Higher = stronger club-colour glow along the edges. Invalid values are reset to default on save.
setup.themeShowTeamNamesHelp: Between logo and score; uses the club’s short name field when possible.
setup.templatesBody: Save your current canvas as a layout, or apply one you saved earlier. A layout is visual only — sponsor rotation stays unchanged.
setup.templatesEmpty: No saved layouts yet. Build one in the editor below and save it.
setup.canvasBody: Set the logical resolution of your stadium display. For pixel-perfect output to an LED wall: set dimensions exactly to your LED panel and choose Pixel-perfect (1:1). ArenaCue then applies no browser scaling, which avoids blur and video stretching.
setup.canvasInvalidDimsDesc: Minimum 320×240. Adjust values and try again.
setup.canvasCoverDesc: Fills the window completely. With a mismatched aspect a edge may be cropped. Default.
setup.canvasContainDesc: Full content visible. Possible black bars with mismatched aspect. Safer for sponsor content.
setup.canvasExactDesc: No browser scaling. Logical resolution = physical resolution. Requires exact LED size.
setup.canvasSafeZoneHelp: Shows a green frame on the stadium display as a guide for LED cabinets whose edges are hidden by the housing. Turn off before the match.
setup.healthBody: Tests all active media in your library. Sponsors, goal videos and rundown clips are loaded to catch codec/read errors and slow clips before kick-off.
setup.healthAllReady: All media ready for the match
setup.healthTimeout: Timeout: file did not respond within 8s
setup.breakMinutesHint: Half-time / main break. Short period breaks and set breaks follow the sport profile.
setup.technicalTimeoutsHint: FIVB abolished the technical time-out; enable only if your league still plays it.

bridge.title: Mobile app
bridge.hint: Scan the QR code or open the address on your phone (same network).
bridge.cloudHint: Also works outside the same network.
bridge.viewerOnlyHint: Default view: viewer-only QR (no operator PIN in the code). Check below to show the operator pairing code and PIN.
bridge.showOperatorSecrets: Show operator PIN and full LAN pairing code (QR)

playerIntro.title: Player intro
playerIntro.help: Pick a team or a player here. Without a choice the screen keeps showing the scoreboard — do not use only the “{{title}}” button in Display mode without a player.
playerIntro.customVisuals: Custom visuals: set a lineup video (fullscreen) and/or photo (graphic template without video) per player under Setup → team → edit player, or in bulk under Lineup videos….
playerIntro.readyHint: Intro is ready. Use Next mainly to follow the stadium announcer.
playerIntro.orderDialogDesc: Prepare the order in advance. During the announcement you only need to click Next.
playerIntro.allInOrder: All players are in the order.

external.title: External capture
external.help: For pro HDMI/SDI capture cards (Magewell, Elgato, Blackmagic): pick the card under Cameras & video input. ArenaCue tries to capture 1920×1080@30 automatically. You can also pick a screen/window for vMix, OBS or other SDI software on this PC. Preview here, then fullscreen on the scoreboard.
external.browserUnavailable: Not available in the browser build.
external.noSources: No sources loaded yet — press Refresh sources.
external.noCameras: No cameras found (or no permission). Check privacy settings for the camera.
external.audioPassthroughHint: for capture cards with sound (vMix/OB van)
external.liveOnDisplay: Live on the display window (above the scoreboard). BLACKOUT pauses this and restores it afterwards.
external.previewEmpty: Pick a source on the right to preview it here.
external.sourceGone: This source is no longer available (window closed or device unplugged). Pick another source.
external.sourceEnded: The source stopped sending video (window closed or cable unplugged).
external.blackoutPaused: BLACKOUT is active — capture is paused and returns automatically when you leave blackout.

livestream.title: Livestream
livestream.help: Several video inputs (camera, HDMI, LED scoreboard, browser or local media) plus a live score overlay, then YouTube, Twitch or a custom RTMP server. Optional microphone or capture audio.
livestream.previewMedia: Choose a local file or something from the media library.
livestream.browserAudioHint: Page audio appears as its own mixer strip.
livestream.browserInteractHelp: ArenaCue uses its own browser profile, not Chrome. Sign in once here; it stays saved.
livestream.previewBrowser: Enter a website URL on this browser source.
livestream.videoInputsHelp: Camera, HDMI, LED scoreboard, website or a local media file. Switch them in the studio with one click.
livestream.needsStreamKey: Add a stream key in Setup first.
livestream.audioFollowHelp: When this video input is program: mute or unmute specific audio automatically. Leave keeps the fader as-is.
livestream.audioHelp: Mix several sources: hall mic, commentator, HDMI and GoXLR channels (Game, Music, System, Chat). Those playback channels are captured via loopback.
livestream.audioEmpty: No audio devices found. Click refresh — Windows may ask for microphone access. Look for GoXLR Broadcast Mix or RODECaster Main Stereo.
livestream.audioMonitorHint: Headphone icon = you hear that source (not the stream). Master icon = the full mix.
livestream.audioMonitorConflict: Don’t pick an output that is also a source, or you will get feedback.
livestream.audioFaderHint: Vertical faders like a mixing desk. The LED meter follows the fader (post-fader). Green is safe, yellow hot, red clip.
livestream.audioMeterLive: Live: mute and faders apply to the stream immediately, without restarting the picture.
livestream.previewQualityHint: The preview is lighter than the broadcast. Twitch/YouTube shows the real quality.
livestream.overlayHelp: Small TV bug: logos, score and timer over the camera. Always 16:9.
livestream.layoutAutoShort: Match clear, sponsors at the break
livestream.layoutAutoHelp: Match first: camera + score. Sponsors and clips only at half-time, prematch and after the game (fullscreen). Cards and substitutions stay short match graphics.
livestream.layoutManualHelp: The preview on the left updates immediately.
livestream.manualPhaseSplit: Separate layout for play and breaks
livestream.sponsorsHelp: In automatic: 16:9 spots (1920×1080) fullscreen during breaks. The camera stays clear during play — enable PiP sponsors under Manual.
livestream.displayLayersHelp: LED source streams the scoreboard window (not the desktop). A website or other window on top will not appear on the stream.
livestream.dualEnabled: Also send to a second platform
livestream.dualHelp: Same picture to YouTube and Twitch (or two custom RTMP servers). One encoder, two destinations.
livestream.previewDisplay: LED picture, the same as the scoreboard.
livestream.sourceLiveHint: You can switch sources while live. The stream will hitch briefly during the switch.
livestream.previewProgramHint: This is the program picture (camera + layers), not the raw camera.
livestream.previewPhasePlay: Now in play: camera and score.
livestream.previewPhaseBreak: Now {{status}}: break layout. The play-time score appears when the half starts.
livestream.widgetDragHint: Drag the widget in the preview. Pull the corner to resize.
livestream.widgetTeamColors: Use club colors in the widget
livestream.widgetOwnDesignsHelp: Save the current look and switch back later. Position stays put.
livestream.widgetPositionHint: Drag the score widget in the preview or snap to a corner below.
livestream.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg is missing. Run npm run livestream:ensure-ffmpeg and restart the app.
livestream.bitrateTooLow: Low for {{resolution}}{{fps}}. {{recommended}} kbps gives noticeably sharper scoreboard digits.
livestream.bitrateTooHigh: Above {{maximum}} kbps adds no visible quality and may be rejected by the platform.
livestream.deckHelp: Build your own keys here. In Stream Deck pick “Studio key” and the number (1 = first key). F13–F24 trigger the same set. Companion: http://127.0.0.1:17891/key/1 …
livestream.deckEmpty: No keys yet — set them up
livestream.deckEmptyHelp: Add keys above. Reorder with the arrows; that is also the hardware order.
livestream.deckPluginOff: Plugin not installed — restart the desktop app

update.body: You are on version {{current}}. The latest version is {{latest}}.
update.bodyFallback: Download the latest build and replace your file.
update.replaceHint: Quit the app and replace Stadium-Scoreboard.exe with the new file.

crash.title: Crash recovery
crash.body: A previous session was found. Resume?
